character: An orc woman in her late twenties, broad through the shoulders and built for dock work, now three weeks underfed and running on pure temper. Greenish-grey skin, small lower tusks, dark hair shorn short and growing out unevenly. Knuckles scarred, a hard furious set to her jaw, eyes alert and angry. A small guild tattoo on the inside of one forearm
wardrobe: dock canvas trousers and a heavy work shirt worn soft with use and filthy from three weeks in a cell, one sleeve torn away at the shoulder, a length of rag knotted around one wrist

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, three-quarter view, weight forward, fists loose, furious and unbowed.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, jaw set, angry alert eyes, shorn dark hair.

scene.framing: Gripping the iron bars of a barred cell in a dim stone basement with both hands, leaning into them, snarling something at whoever is on the other side, red light from somewhere behind her.
